blocks.text: . ⁧هٰذَا كِتَابِي⁩ demo + name with suffix = phrase This is my book.

Because that's how it works. The demonstration is already determined. If the following name is indeterminate, there is a jump of determination and then a sentence boundary (as in ⁧البَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ⁩ , A1-04). If the name has the article, demonstrative and name form a single block: this book is ". To say "this" is the book "with a determined predicate," it inserts ⁧هُوَ⁩ / ⁧هِيَ⁩ to mark the border. With the suffix, the demo goes later.
